BiblicalUsage: Ahihud, son of Shelomi, was the prince of Asher appointed to divide the land of Canaan, named once among the ten princes who stood with Eleazar and Joshua to allot the inheritance.
TheologicalSignificance: No doctrine hangs on this prince. His appointment is part of the order God set on the conquest: the land was not grabbed, it was divided by lot, by named men, under God's direction.
